contentBlocks.title: SASSA Payment Dates — August 2026
contentBlocks.description: Full payout schedule for August 2026 including the new 4th day cycle. Older Persons: 4 Aug, Disability: 5 Aug, Children: 6 Aug, review day: 7 Aug, SRD R370: 25-31 Aug. Plan your collection with our detailed guide.

contentBlocks.text: SASSA has published the August 2026 payment schedule. This month introduces a new 4th-day payment window — 7 August — which has been added specifically for grant reviews and backlog clearances. Beneficiaries should take note of the adjusted schedule and plan their collections accordingly.

Starting in August 2026, SASSA has introduced a fourth payment window on the 7th of each month, primarily to accommodate grant review outcomes and backlog payments. Previously, grant reviews were processed ad hoc throughout the month, causing confusion. This new dedicated day streamlines payments for beneficiaries whose reviews are finalised by the end of the previous month.

contentBlocks.title: 4th-Day Payments Are Not for Everyone
contentBlocks.text: The new 4th-day payment date (7 August) is specifically for grant review beneficiaries, backdated payments, and exceptional cases. If you receive your grant on a regular cycle without any review pending, continue collecting on your usual date (4, 5, or 6 August).

contentBlocks.text: How the Grant Review Process Works

steps.title: You receive a review notice
steps.description: SASSA sends a letter or SMS to inform you that your grant is due for review. This typically happens once a year for permanent grants.

steps.title: Visit your SASSA office with documents
steps.description: Take your ID, proof of residence, and any income-related documents to your nearest SASSA office. The officer will update your information.

steps.title: SASSA processes the review
steps.description: Your file is updated and reviewed internally. If everything is in order, your grant continues uninterrupted. If changes are needed, you will be notified.

steps.title: Payment on the new 4th-day cycle
steps.description: If your review is approved after the standard payment dates have passed, you will receive your backdated payment on the 4th day (7th of the month).

faqs.question: What is the new 4th-day cycle and who qualifies for it?
faqs.answer: The 4th-day cycle is a new payment window on the 7th of each month. It is for beneficiaries whose grants are under review, those receiving backdated payments, and exceptional cases where the regular payment window was missed. It does not replace the existing three payment dates.

faqs.question: I collect my Older Persons Grant on the 4th. Will this change in August?
faqs.answer: No. Your payment date remains 4 August 2026. The new 4th-day cycle (7 August) is an additional window, not a replacement. Only collect on the 7th if SASSA has specifically notified you that your payment falls under the new cycle.

faqs.question: How do I know if my grant is under review?
faqs.answer: SASSA will notify you by SMS or post if your grant is due for review. You can also check your status at any SASSA office or by calling the toll-free helpline on 0800 60 10 11. Do not wait for a notice if you have changed address — update your details proactively.

faqs.question: Will the SRD R370 be paid on the same day as the 4th-day cycle?
faqs.answer: No. The 4th-day cycle (7 August) is for permanent grant beneficiaries flagged for reviews and eLife certification. SRD R370 payments for August 2026 are processed separately in the 25-31 August window, as normal.

faqs.question: What happens if my grant review is not completed by August?
faqs.answer: If your review is still in progress at the end of July, your payment for August may be delayed until the review is finalised. You will receive backdated payment once approved. Contact your SASSA office for an update on the review timeline.

contentBlocks.title: Avoid Scams During Review Season
contentBlocks.answer: Fraudsters often target beneficiaries during review periods. SASSA will never ask for your PIN, password, or bank account details over the phone. Do not pay anyone who promises to 'fast-track' your review. All SASSA services are free.
